title: What the Ukrainian Strikes on Yandex Tell Us About Central Asia’s Digital Infrastructure
gist: Ukrainian drone strikes on three Yandex facilities in Russia caused outages that spilled over to Central Asian users of Yandex Go, exposing the region's dependence on Russian digital infrastructure. The excerpt is truncated.

insights.claim: Three Yandex facilities in Russia were struck by Ukrainian drones over a weekend, and after the third strike on a data center in Vladimir east of Moscow, Central Asian users of Yandex Go also reported outages.
insights.speaker: Catherine Putz
insights.so_what: Physical strikes on Russian data centers create cross-border service risk for Russian-hosted platforms.

insights.claim: Yandex Search holds an estimated 72 percent share in Russia and just under 30 percent in Kazakhstan, while the Yandex Go superapp dominates Central Asia.
insights.speaker: Catherine Putz
insights.so_what: Quantifies Central Asian exposure to a single Russian tech provider.
